fluff.overview: The Com Guards field conventional infantry as a core component of their combined-arms formations, with Level I infantry units integrated into the same command structure alongside BattleMech, armor, and aerospace elements at every organizational level. Jump infantry Level I formations provide the vertical mobility needed to operate in urban environments and mountainous terrain. Com Guard jump troops train to exploit three-dimensional movement as a tactical advantage, clearing rooftops and elevated positions that conventional foot infantry cannot reach without significant delay. Carrying infantry-portable machine guns that provide sustained suppressive fire, these troops anchor defensive positions with a volume of fire that discourages enemy movement in the open.
